query: INSERT INTO auth.users (id, instance_id, email, encrypted_password, email_confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, aud, role) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid, 'owner@bolt.app', crypt('Owner2025', gen_salt('bf')), now(), now(), now(), 'authenticated', 'authenticated' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.users WHERE email='owner@bolt.app') RETURNING id
